Require the delegated task to validate its fully populated completion envelope against the dispatch before delivery
Treat missing or failed pre-send validation as non-passing and prohibit pass callbacks
Preserve callback or one event-wait delivery and one terminal-readback recovery without polling
non_goals: Repair a failed validation inside the delegated task
Create or push a release tag

Update templates, validator, routing guidance, and focused tests
Commit a clean immutable checkpoint and run one real source-task callback regression
